WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing') AS mix,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior a
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink
  GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'Missing')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT mix,
         cnt,
         cnt::numeric / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share
  FROM grouped
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT s.mix,
       s.cnt AS count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS above_avg_by
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY s.share DESC;
